name: Software Development
description: Software development domain with CI/CD and code review covering full-stack development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

phase_prompts.research: Research technical requirements, existing solutions, libraries, and architecture patterns.
phase_prompts.decision: Define technical architecture, choose tech stack, establish coding standards.
phase_prompts.execution: Implement features following coding standards and architecture decisions.
phase_prompts.feedback: Code review, performance analysis, security audit, test coverage verification.
phase_prompts.delivery: Build, tag, and deploy to target environment with release notes.
